from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A financial metric extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's security/trading code if available")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial statement")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written in the report")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported numerical amount for this metric")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., '元')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
